title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Explore the unique customs and rituals that define the entrepreneurial spirit and history of Babson College.

cards.title: Founder's Day
cards.subtitle: Celebrating Roger Babson since 1947
cards.notes: Join the community for apple-themed treats and carnival games to honor Roger Babson's legacy and his admiration for Sir Isaac Newton.
cards.short_summary: An annual fall celebration honoring the college's founder with apple-themed events and community gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Founder's Day is a fall tradition since 1947 that honors Roger Babson with activities including apple-themed lunch and Founder's Fest.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in September across the Wellesley campus.

cards.title: The Spinning World Globe
cards.subtitle: A 25-ton symbol of global reach
cards.notes: Visit the restored 28-foot rotating globe in Kerry Murphy Healey Park, a landmark commissioned by Roger Babson in 1947.
cards.short_summary: A massive, rotating globe that serves as a central campus landmark and symbol of Babson's global perspective.
cards.evidence_claim: The Babson Globe, weighing 25 tons and 28 feet in diameter, was restored and moved to Kerry Murphy Healey Park in 2019.
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors in Kerry Murphy Healey Park, accessible 24/7.

cards.title: The Great Beaver Hunt
cards.subtitle: Finding 100 hidden beavers
cards.notes: Search the campus for 100 hidden toy beavers during Spirit Week to win prizes and show your Babson pride.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide scavenger hunt for hidden beaver figurines held during the annual Spirit Week.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Beaver Hunt involves hiding 100 beavers around campus for students to find and win prizes during Spirit Week.
cards.source_title: Undergraduate Student Life Events - Babson College
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually during Spirit Week leading up to Back to Babson.

cards.title: Late-Night Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Fueling finals with faculty service
cards.notes: Head to Trim Dining Hall before finals to enjoy breakfast served by your favorite faculty and staff members.
cards.short_summary: A finals-week tradition where faculty and staff serve breakfast foods to students late at night in the dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Late-Night Breakfast is held at the end of the fall semester at Trim Dining Hall, with food served by faculty and staff.
cards.source_title: Undergraduate Student Life Events - Babson College
cards.access_notes: Held late at night during finals week at Trim Dining Hall.

cards.title: Cruickshank Race for Shelter
cards.subtitle: Running for a cause since 2003
cards.notes: Participate in this annual 5K run during Family and Friends Weekend to support service immersion trips and Habitat for Humanity.
cards.short_summary: A charitable 5K race held annually to raise funds for student service trips and local housing initiatives.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cruickshank Race for Shelter is an annual 5K held during Family and Friends Weekend, named after alumnus Bill Cruickshank.
cards.source_title: Babson on the Run · Babson Thought & Action
cards.access_notes: Typically starts at Hollister Hall during Family and Friends Weekend in October.

cards.title: Buffoonery
cards.subtitle: Graduate student variety show
cards.notes: Watch graduate students perform skits and songs that playfully poke fun at the Babson experience and faculty.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring variety show coordinated by graduate students featuring good-natured irreverence and skits.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffoonery is an annual spring variety show coordinated by Babson graduate students featuring skits and songs.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the spring, primarily for the graduate student community.

cards.title: The Great Babson Bake-Off
cards.subtitle: Sweet relief during finals
cards.notes: Sample treats baked by faculty and staff and vote for your favorite during this Grad Rejuvenation Week event.
cards.short_summary: A baking competition where faculty and staff provide treats for graduate students during final exams.
cards.evidence_claim: The bake-off began in 2011 as part of Grad Rejuvenation Week, where staff and faculty bake treats for students to vote on.
cards.access_notes: Held during Grad Rejuvenation Week in the fall and spring semesters.

cards.title: Together Under the Tent
cards.subtitle: The heart of homecoming
cards.notes: Gather with alumni and families under the big tent for the signature celebration of Reunion and Homecoming weekend.
cards.short_summary: The central social gathering of the Back to Babson weekend, bringing together the entire college community.
cards.evidence_claim: Back to Babson brings the community 'Together Under the Tent' for Reunion, Homecoming, and Family Weekend.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in September, typically on the Park Manor Quad.

cards.title: MLK Jr. Legacy Day
cards.subtitle: Honoring diversity and inclusion
cards.notes: Attend guest lectures and award ceremonies that celebrate the values of Dr. King and recognize community leadership.
cards.short_summary: An annual day of reflection and celebration focused on diversity, inclusion, and the teachings of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.
cards.evidence_claim: Martin Luther King Jr. Legacy Day includes guest speakers, leadership awards, and a creativity contest.
cards.source_title: Undergraduate Student Life Events - Babson College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in January to coincide with MLK Day.

cards.title: Last Bingo
cards.subtitle: A final senior week tradition
cards.notes: Join your graduating class in Knight Auditorium for one final high-stakes game of bingo before commencement.
cards.short_summary: A popular Senior Week event where graduating undergraduates gather for a final communal bingo game.
cards.evidence_claim: Last Bingo is a signature event for undergraduates during Senior Week, held in Knight Auditorium.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to graduating undergraduate seniors during Senior Week in May.
